Tenzin Dorji  
📞 +44 7700 900123 | 📧 tenzin.dorji@advertisesphere.com | 📍 London, UK  

Professional Experience  
As a senior security engineer at AdvertiseSphere Technologies, I oversee the architecture and operations of security systems that protect high-value ad-tech infrastructure. My work spans identity management, encryption protocols, and continuous security audits, ensuring alignment with global standards. Previously, as lead security engineer at AdvertiseSphere, I spearheaded the migration to zero-trust architecture, reducing unauthorized access attempts by 42% within 18 months. At MediaGuard Analytics, I designed and deployed enterprise IAM systems, integrating over 200 third-party services while maintaining compliance with GDPR and CCPA. Early in my career at ClickFusion Startups, I built foundational security frameworks for ad-tech platforms, laying the groundwork for scalable threat detection models.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Cybersecurity, University of California, Berkeley (2018). Graduated with distinction, specializing in secure system design and cryptographic protocols. My thesis on distributed identity management systems was recognized for its practical application in cloud environments.  

Professional Summary  
Over six years, I’ve evolved from a security analyst to a strategic architect, shaping the security posture of ad-tech enterprises with measurable outcomes. My expertise lies in designing systems that balance operational efficiency with enterprise-grade security, ensuring compliance, mitigating risks, and fostering innovation. I’ve led cross-functional teams to implement robust security frameworks, mentor junior engineers, and drive industry-standard compliance. My work directly impacts the integrity of advertising ecosystems, safeguarding against evolving threats while enabling seamless user experiences.  

Projects  
- **Zero-Trust Architecture Migration**: Led the redesign of AdvertiseSphere’s security model, integrating micro-segmentation and dynamic access controls. Reduced lateral movement risks by 65% and improved incident response times by 30%.  
- **Global IAM Integration**: Developed a unified identity management system across 15 regional offices, streamlining access while maintaining strict access controls. Reduced administrative overhead by 50% and eliminated 12 critical compliance gaps.  
- **End-to-End Encryption Framework**: Designed and deployed encryption protocols for ad-tech data pipelines, ensuring end-to-end security for user metadata. Achieved 100% compliance with FIPS 140-2 standards and minimized data exposure risks.  
- **Security Training Program**: Established a company-wide training initiative, reducing incident response times by 25% through improved threat awareness and procedural rigor.  

Certifications  
- Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) | 2021  
- Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) | 2019  
- Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) | 2017  
- AWS Certified Security – Specialty | 2020  

Awards & Achievements  
- AdvertiseSphere Technologies – “Security Architect of the Year” (2023) for leading the zero-trust initiative.  
- MediaGuard Analytics – “Innovation in IAM” Award (2021) for pioneering cross-platform identity integration.  
- Recognized by Infosecurity Europe 2022 for contributions to ad-tech security frameworks.  
- Published research on secure ad-tech infrastructure at Black Hat Europe 2021, cited in industry whitepapers.
